title: Neither Minimum nor Maximum
summary: Given an array of distinct positive integers nums, return any element that is neither the minimum nor the maximum of nums, or -1 if no such element exists.
officialConstraints: 1 <= nums.length <= 100; 1 <= nums[i] <= 100; nums values are distinct.
visualizationNotes: Input is capped at 100 values as in the official constraints. Output 3 for [3,2,1,4] is one of the two accepted answers, chosen as the first valid element.
